answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor whose quartz-timed clock signs a periodic liveness proof no wallet can mint in bulk. Standing only trickles in through one narrow inlet: audited work co-signed by several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters on the far side of a deep canyon. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so every endorsement traces back and never crosses the canyon to distinct clusters; the farm pays a fresh anchor per head while an honest agent anchors once.
